title: Agentic SDLC Approval Registry
description: Validates the structure of the project permission registry; it does not enforce tool access or verify human approvals.

$schema.description: Relative path to the schema used to validate this registry.

version.description: Version of the approval registry format.

pipeline.description: Pipeline-wide human approval and progression settings.

requireApprovalBetweenPhases.description: Whether explicit human approval is required at every phase transition.

allowAutoAdvance.description: Whether the pipeline may advance without a separate human transition decision.

humanInTheLoop.description: Whether a human participates in pipeline approval decisions.

globalPolicies.description: Global action limits applied in addition to phase permissions; a denial takes precedence.

allowFileDeletion.description: Permission to delete files, including deletion performed indirectly by commands.

allowGitPush.description: Permission to push local commits or branches to a remote repository.

allowGitCommit.description: Permission to create local Git commits.

allowRunCommands.description: Global permission for executing commands, additionally restricted by phase permissions.

allowInstallDependencies.description: Global permission to install or change dependencies; network and file-write limits also apply.

allowNetworkAccess.description: Permission for network requests, including package downloads and GitHub API calls.

blockSecretsInOutput.description: When true, secrets must not be exposed in responses, reports, logs, or command output.

phases.description: The eight ordered specialist phases and their permission records.

code-review.description: Peer code review and report permissions.

verify.description: Test authoring, execution, and verification reporting permissions.

pr.description: Release documentation and pull request creation permissions.

permission.description: true or approved permits an action within all other limits; false or locked denies it; ask requires explicit approval before execution.

phaseName.description: An existing phase identifier in pipeline order.

phase.description: A specialist permission record; approval to start is distinct from approval to complete.

agent.description: Dedicated specialist agent responsible for this phase.

status.description: Phase entry state: locked prevents work; approved authorizes eligible work but does not indicate completion.

canWriteFiles.description: Allowlisted repository-relative paths or globs; ** matches descendants. Unlisted write targets are denied.

items.description: A forward-slash relative path or glob without absolute roots, backslashes, or parent-directory traversal.

canRunCommands.description: Phase permission to run commands, subject to global command and action restrictions.

canInstallDependencies.description: Phase permission for dependency installation; absence grants no installation permission.

canCreatePR.description: Phase permission to create a PR; global network and Git policies remain applicable.

canMergePR.description: Phase permission to merge a PR; agent boundaries may impose a stricter prohibition.

requiresApprovalPerTask.description: Whether explicit human approval is required before each individual implementation task.

requiresApprovalToComplete.description: Whether a human must explicitly approve completion after the exit gate is checked.

approvedBy.description: Identity of the human who confirmed phase completion; null means completion approval is not recorded. Must not contain credentials.

dependsOn.description: Predecessor phase whose exit gate and human completion approval must be satisfied first.

exitGate.description: Required completion evidence, supplemented by the orchestrator and specialist quality gates.
